resources.string: On Android 17 or later, allow Nearby devices before enabling this plugin in the AutoJs6 plugin center. You can also manage this permission from the Settings page for this plugin. Without permission, the plugin stays disabled and automatic startup is skipped silently. The grant belongs to this plugin, independently of AutoJs6.
Open this plugin in the AutoJs6 plugin center, choose Settings, then allow local network access.
No separate permission is required on this Android version.
Provides the Node.js 24.21.0 native runtime for AutoJs6

Leave the queue limit blank for unlimited waiting (default), or enter 0 to reject waiting scripts. Parallel slots: 1-8, default 2. Changes apply to new work; running scripts and accepted queued scripts are preserved.
Enter a whole number from 0 to 2147483647, or leave blank.
Saved. Running scripts will finish normally.
